verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a consumer 2FA app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Authy's source code is published under an open license. The only GitHub project mentioned (alexzorin/authy) is a third-party export tool, not the product's own source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
